title: Planet resources and influence raised by attachments
description: A planet's resources and influence icons now show what the planet is worth now: printed value plus attachments (Mining World, Dyson Sphere, Tomb of Emphidia ...), laws (Core Mining, Senate Sanctuary, Terraforming Initiative) and Helios docks, wherever the icons appear. A raised number is green with a small +N badge, and its tooltip reads for example '5 resources (3 printed; Mining World: +2 resources)'. The extra comes from the engine's own planet value function through the new display-only PlanetView.value_boosts, so the UI cannot differ from what payment counts. Mocked fixtures: Lodor (printed 3R/1I) with Mining World, Quann (2R/1I) with Dyson Sphere (both kinds), Jord (2R/2I) under Core Mining.

shots.heading: Map
shots.caption: The pills under Lodor (5+ resources), Quann (4+ and 2+) and Jord (4+) are green where a planet is raised; unboosted values keep their colours.

shots.heading: System inspector
shots.caption: Lodor: 5 resources with a +2 badge; influence stays 1.

shots.heading: Inspector, both kinds raised
shots.caption: Dyson Sphere raises Quann's resources (+2) and influence (+1).

shots.heading: Tile hover
shots.caption: The hover list uses the same component.

shots.heading: Payment drawer
shots.caption: Both values beside each planet; the worth that counts for payment (5 for Lodor, 4 for Quann and Jord) is the raised one.

shots.heading: Payment bar and map
shots.caption: Pick on map: the pills on the planets carry the raised numbers.

shots.heading: Vote: exhaust planets
shots.caption: Quann's 2 votes (influence) are marked as raised by Dyson Sphere's +1; Lodor and Jord (Core Mining raises resources only) are not.

shots.heading: Player sheet
shots.caption: Ready / total resources and influence count the raised values.

notes.title: Where the value comes from
notes.text: Rust: production::planet_value_boosts (laws::planet_value_bonus_sources, attachment records, Helios docks) sums to planet_value_now - planet_value, and the host copies it into PlanetView.value_boosts. Web: planetValues.ts, PlanetValue / PlanetValuePair (boosts or planetId), PlanetBoostContext. Fixtures are synthetic.
